P.note: The most exuberant Frutiger Aero take (sun rays, lime gel CTA, green-label translucent vinyl, bubbles), but crowded with stat chips, a live-listener tag and stray orbs that dilute the hero.

Q.note: Most convincing material: the vinyl visibly refracts the clouds behind it through layered multiply/screen tint, half-sleeved in tinted PVC and casting caustic light on the grass, all in a clean, legible composition.

R.note: Very legible and accessibility-minded with excellent blade-level grass, but the pale sky, navy type and clip-art clouds lose the saturated, luminous Aero feel.

S.note: Beautifully refractive disc and rich player card, but floating feature chips, an avatar-and-stars trust pill and a chrome-outlined headline line make it busy and template-like.

T.note: Clean and legible, but the disc reads as an opaque painted frisbee and the washed-out sky with cartoon clouds misses the translucent-color brief.

U.note: Saturated sky, strong sun glare and a record-in-sleeve concept, but the sleeve reads as a large flat blue panel and the player card awkwardly overlaps it.
